args.title: Juniper Labware: Warehouse automation in 2026 (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
- Newsletter: Juniper Labware's latest issue covers "Warehouse automation in 2026," linking to the full article (and a mirror for chart rendering).
- Article: Autonomous carts lifted pick rates by 18%, but integration took twice as long as planned.
- Companion piece: The single biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.

Source: newsletter@juniper.example → https://blog.juniper.example/2026/warehouse → https://insights.juniper.example/warehouse/companion
